items.quote: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me
items.claim: The people shall confess their iniquity and their fathers' iniquity
items.object: their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass

items.quote: and that also they have walked contrary unto me
items.claim: The people have walked contrary to God

items.quote: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies
items.claim: God has walked contrary to the people

items.quote: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies
items.claim: God has brought the people into the land of their enemies

items.quote: if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled
items.claim: The people's uncircumcised hearts shall be humbled

items.quote: and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity
items.claim: The people shall accept the punishment of their iniquity

items.quote: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob
items.claim: God will remember His covenant with Jacob

items.quote: and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember
items.claim: God will remember His covenants with Isaac and Abraham
items.object: my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham

items.quote: and I will remember the land
